t.zh: 一条条件命题的结论也可以是另一条条件命题。例如，「若今天是周六，则（若下雨，则我休息）」说的是：在今天是周六的条件下，「若下雨，则我休息」成立。
t.en: The conclusion of a conditional can itself be another conditional. For example, “if today is Saturday, then (if it rains, I rest)” says that the whole statement “if it rains, I rest” holds on the condition that today is Saturday.

t.zh: 括号表明哪些话属于同一层。一次套用得到的结论可以是一整条条件命题；这条命题也能像其他已知一样，作为之后推理的前提。
t.en: The parentheses show which parts belong together. One use of Apply can produce an entire conditional, which can then serve as a premise in further reasoning, just like a given.

hint.zh: 套用的结果本身也可以是一句「若…则…」。
hint.en: What Apply gives can itself be an “if … then …”.

hint.zh: 最后一句已知的前件是什么？
hint.en: What is the antecedent of the last given?
